name: Rue
source:
A hard working and skilled potter with a tendency to overthink and have conversations inside her head. Although she's sweet and kind, Rue is a bit of a people pleaser.

After meeting Parker, she starts being more honest with herself and smiling more often.

[From [url=https://prikarin.itch.io/potion-pleasing]itch.io[/url]]
